introduction:
The Ration Card in Delhi is issued by the Department of Food, Supplies and Consumer Affairs, Government of NCT of Delhi. It aims to ensure food security for eligible residents by providing subsidised food grains (wheat, rice, sugar) through Fair Price Shops (FPS).

In Delhi, rationing is predominantly online and Aadhaar-driven under the National Food Security Act (NFSA). Note: The eldest female member (above 18 years) of the family must be designated as the Head of the Family on the ration card.
quickFacts:
Important to Know
  • Application Availability: Online applications for new Ration Cards and adding family members have officially resumed in Delhi.
  • Processing Time: The standard processing time for issuing a new Ration Card is approximately 30 days.
  • Head of Family (HOF): By government rules, the HOF must be the eldest female member (18 years or above). An eldest male can only be the HOF if there are no adult female members in the family.
  • Income Limit: The annual family income must be less than ₹1,20,000 to be eligible.
  • Vehicle Ownership: Families owning a personal four-wheeler are not eligible. However, owning one commercial four-wheeler (e.g., a taxi used for livelihood) is permitted.
  • Electricity Rules: The sanctioned electricity meter load for a single family must be less than 2 kW. If the load is 3 kW or more, the applicant is only eligible if the meter is shared among multiple families (e.g., different floors).
  • Property Rules: No family member should own land or a house in A, B, C, D, or E category (posh/developed) colonies in Delhi.
  • Employment & Taxes: No family member should be a government employee (Central, State, or MCD) or an income tax payee.
  • Uniqueness: No family member should be listed on any other ration card in Delhi or any other state in India.
documentsRequired:
Documents Required for Ration Card

Requirement: Ensure you have scanned soft copies (under 200KB for documents, 50KB for photos) for online upload, and keep the original documents ready.
Mandatory Documents
  • Income Proof Certificate: Mandatory and must be officially issued in the name of the female HOF (PDF/JPG, max 200 KB).
  • Electricity Bill: Required to verify your meter load and CA number.
  • Self-Declaration Form: Must be downloaded from the portal, printed, filled, signed by the HOF, scanned, and uploaded.
  • Passport-Size Photograph: A clear photo of the HOF with a plain background (JPG/JPEG format, max 50 KB). A live capture option via webcam is also available.
Identity & Address Proofs
  • Aadhaar Cards: Copies of Aadhaar Cards for all the family members being added to the ration card.
  • Residence Proof: You can use documents like an Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Bank Passbook, Rent Agreement, Passport, Driving License, or Utility Bills.
    Note: Utility bills (Electricity, Water, Gas) must not be older than 3 months.
onlineApplication:
Method 1: Apply Online via e-District Delhi Portal

Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Step 1: Portal Registration: Visit the e-District Delhi portal. If you are a new user, click on 'Register'. Registration requires the Aadhaar Card of the HOF. Fill in the personal details, email ID, and mobile number. You will receive an Access Code and Password via SMS/Email to complete the setup.
  2. Step 2: Login: Log in to your account using your new User ID and Password.
  3. Step 3: Select Service: Go to the 'Apply Online' tab at the top and select 'Apply for Services'. Scroll down to the Department of Food & Supply section and click on 'Apply' next to Issuance of Priority Household Card (PHH).
  4. Step 4: Basic Details: Verify your personal details on the screen and click 'Continue'.
  5. Step 5: Fill the Form:
    • Select 'PHH' under Application Applied For.
    • Ensure the Eldest Female Member is selected as the HOF and input her profession.
    • Answer the eligibility questions accurately (citizenship, income tax payee status, property ownership, government employment, vehicle ownership).
    • Fill in electricity connection details (Provider name, CA number, load capacity, and number of families sharing the meter).
    • Enter Bank Account details (optional, but helpful for direct subsidies).
    • Select three Fair Price Shops (FPS) / Ration depots closest to your home from the drop-down list.
  6. Step 6: Add Family Members: In the family details section, add all eligible family members one by one by entering their Aadhaar details and their relationship with the HOF.
  7. Step 7: Upload Documents: Accept the declaration and proceed to upload your Income Certificate, Residence Proof, Aadhaar Cards, Electricity Bill, and the signed Self-Declaration.
  8. Step 8: Upload Photo: Upload the passport-size photo of the HOF or capture one using your device's camera.
  9. Step 9: Final Submit: Review the form for any errors and click 'Final Submit'.
offlineApplication:
Method 2: Apply Offline

Note: The following procedure is sourced from the official guidelines of the Food, Supplies and Consumer Affairs Department, Delhi.
Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Step 1: Download Form: Visit the official portal of the Department of Food, Supplies and Consumer Affairs (NFS Delhi) at nfs.delhigovt.nic.in and download the new Ration Card application form.
  2. Step 2: Fill Details: Fill out the hard copy of the form completely. Ensure the head of the family is the eldest female member.
  3. Step 3: Attach Documents: Attach self-attested photocopies of all mandatory documents (Income Certificate, Residence Proof, Aadhaar cards of all members, Passport size photos, etc.).
  4. Step 4: Visit Office: Go to your respective zonal/circle Food and Supplies Office.
  5. Step 5: Submit: Submit the duly filled form along with the supporting documents to the concerned officer.
  6. Step 6: Acknowledgement: Collect your acknowledgement slip/receipt from the counter, which contains your application number for future tracking.
afterApplying:
After Applying - Next Steps & Tracking

Acknowledgement Slip

Once submitted online or offline, an Acknowledgement Receipt will be generated containing an Application Number. Keep this safe.

Track Status

You can check the live status of your application on the e-District portal or the NFS Delhi website using your Application Number.

Department Queries

If the department finds any missing or incorrect documents, they will notify you via SMS. You can resolve this by logging into the e-District portal, navigating to the 'Pending for Submission' tab, and re-uploading the requested documents (e.g., an updated Income Certificate).
